dedupe_keys.name: nevada data centre tax abatement and resource use tables

description: This repository compiles Nevada data-centre tax-abatement records and related facility, water and energy information. Max Doubin publishes thirteen CSV tables, including twelve award records and 33 facility entries, with a generated field dictionary. Award fields separate promised investment, jobs and wages from reported abatements and later audited outcomes. Source and discrepancy tables retain document identifiers, retrieval dates and conflicting values. Coverage is Nevada, with different observation years across tables; the documented Reno redemption series covers fiscal years 2017–2024. Public CSV access is free under CC BY 4.0, while the supporting code uses MIT. A limitation is that facility presence does not imply an abatement, and program-wide audit tables include aviation and other programs as well as data centres. Several recent awards rely on secondary reporting, and redemption coverage outside Reno is incomplete. Simulation uses include economic scenarios for data-centre expansion and comparisons between fiscal incentives and resource demand. It complements data-atlas-global-data-center-map with policy and outcome fields. The README and dictionary disagree on the source-table row count, so that count is not adopted. No CSV rows or original financial documents were downloaded.
